subject: Add the mid-air boost jolt and a red boost-bar alert
body:
- Second jump press in the air with at least 20% boost fires a jolt twice as strong and
  costly as Shift's, along the current trajectory, with a bigger shockwave and boom.
- Not enough boost flashes a red outline on the boost bar.
- Jolt tests moved to tests/jolt_smoke.gd to stay under the file token limit.

subject: Make ladybugs raise top speed and beetles raise boost capacity
body:
- Ladybug: +1 km/h normal top speed for the rest of the run.
- Beetle: +1% of the original boost meter capacity (and fills that amount).
- Perks reset on restart; HUD shows charge against capacity and the arc fills at the raised top speed.

subject: Rebuild the leaderboard page as a table and give both site pages matching nav buttons
Strengthen the boost jolt, keep overspeed, and require boosting to break obstacles
body:
- Jolt starts steeper with a gentler taper and stays half strength at top speed.
- Jolt sound is quieter and loses the wind-like tail; wind follows speed only.
- Speed above the limit decays with a light drag instead of 25 m/s^2.
- Obstacles break only while boosting.

subject: Stop tracking Wrangler's local cache
Start the run clock on first movement, reset fully on restart, add menu leaderboard and the vh.hobbyhood.app site
body:
- Clock waits for the runner to move; restart clears clock, jump, pose and speed effects.
- Esc/Controls menus (desktop and phone) open the leaderboard and show site links and version.
- /leaderboard and /changelog pages are published with the game; a version is a commit.
- Cloudflare Worker proxy serves the game, leaderboard and changelog at vh.hobbyhood.app.

subject: Add boost jolt, larger lake, forward-leading water camera, red trajectory speed effects and quicker steering
body:
- Boost press fires a distorting shockwave jolt that tapers into normal boost,
  weaker when already fast, with extra charge cost, FOV kick and forward lean.
- Lake is 46% longer and wider with the route's flat-water stretch extended;
  water-section camera is zoomed out and looks ahead.
- Fire dome, boost shell and red streaks follow the real trajectory; motion blur
  scales with speed and slope; synthesized boom, jolt and wind sounds.
- Fast turning when slow or stopped; action grid reordered with spacing;
  boost meter eases between engine samples.
- Leaderboard client backs off on failure and ignores the production board on localhost.

subject: Point the game at the deployed leaderboard Worker
Add end-of-run leaderboard, portrait support, rope-bridge gorges and layered rock
body:
- Cloudflare Worker + KV leaderboard with signed run tokens; client falls back to
  device-only times until server/leaderboard/url.txt is set.
- Tall windows and portrait phones get a matching canvas shape and widened camera FOV.
- First crossing uses the rope-bridge asset; all three get river, boulders and rock faces.
- Shared rock_finish() adds strata, crevices and streaks to terrain and mountains.
- Triangle guard now per crossing; measurements recorded in docs.

subject: Ship blue/orange HUD skin with tilt, fullscreen, pickup and bridge updates
body:
Cut the user-supplied blue/orange sheet into a transparent atlas and
unlit/lit gauge layers; speed arc and boost segments light from live state.

subject: Record verified mobile web publication
Ship calibrated phone tilt controls with multitouch fallback
Record final waterfall presentation and public release verification
Remaster waterfall transparency, grounded portal and cave depth
Eliminate mountain layer Z fighting and stippled seams
Retune 300 km/h boost, camera and waterfall cave
Add glowing insect collectible rows with pooled feedback and chimes
Replace lake wake strips with connected rolling water geometry
Add rechargeable boost and speed-sensitive individual prop impacts
Add winding mountain climb and long steep descent
Fix incline jumps and grade-following camera; add bounded ultrawide support
Enrich hillside cover, preserve tree canopies and refine off-route geology
Place review captures on actual bridge decks and terrain
Ground scenery and add layered mountain, bridge and cave environments
body:
Use mesh-derived trunk and rock collision, actual terrain support, shared detiled terrain materials and supplied parallax mountain layers. Replace the hanging crossing with an optimized CC0 suspension bridge over a shared river channel; add a solid waterfall tunnel.

Preserve bounded streaming and tree LODs, hold benchmark teleports until neighboring terrain is ready, record build timings, and guard publication against changing the browser-tested pack.

Validation: full structural suite and complete route traversal; final fresh local gate/export in 106.8s; focused 1080p Chrome/RTX3060Ti bridge and lake checks near100FPS without loading waits or frames over50ms; public artifact hashes verified.
